purpose: Teach: 澆/椶/僂/彡/シーク/同省/未確認/西方

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、農学の澆水、つまり澆灌の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you covered irrigation research in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, professorial. Gently affirming. Relaxed pace. Eyes soft with genuine interest in the student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、椶櫚、つまり椶の植物分類研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched palm tree taxonomy in my paper.
lines.style: Direct, clear, steady voice. No hedging. Slight lift at the end showing she's engaged, not just complying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 僂佝、つまり僂の姿勢病の医学史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored the medical history of postural deformity in your work, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pacing. Slight pause before the main phrase. Curious tone — genuinely interested in how she'll respond.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、漢字の彡、つまり彡偏の書道研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I did research on the san radical in calligraphy and character writing.
lines.style: Assured, articulate. Speaks with quiet confidence. No hesitation — she knows her subject.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: シーク教徒、つまりシーク派の宗教研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also looked at Sikhism and religious scholarship in your paper?
lines.style: Curious, slightly reflective. Gentle confirmation-seeking. Patient pause, letting the question breathe.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、同省、つまり同省内文書の行政研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched administrative documents and government policy through that lens.
lines.style: Clear and composed. Slightly faster tempo showing she's tracking the thread. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 未確認生物、つまりUMA研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And cryptozoology — unconfirmed creatures — you covered that as well?
lines.style: Warm curiosity with a hint of gentle humor. Slight lilt on the second phrasing. Relaxed, like she's enjoying the conversation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、西方浄土、つまり西方の仏教観研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the Pure Land Buddhist concept and its philosophical foundations.
lines.style: Assured, thoughtful conclusion. Slightly slower, more deliberate. Finality in the delivery, like closing a chapter.
